description:
Plain jakarta.servlet Filter/Servlet glue (Jackson 3 / tools.jackson.* line). No Jackson coupling of its
    own, but ServletModule implements crnk-core's Module interface, whose ModuleContext type differs between
    the crnk-core and crnk-core-jackson3 lines - needs its own build against crnk-core-jackson3 for that
    reason alone, same as crnk-setup-spring.
